evidence.quotation: When your opponent Normal or Flip Summons a monster with 1000 or more ATK: Target that monster; destroy that target.
evidence.historicalApplicability: Current semantics reference; 2002 LOB print evidence separate. Not claiming 2005 printed wording.
Goat compilation labels this Netrep ruling. Community source, not authenticated original UDE publication.

notes: Normal Trap speed 2; Set in own Main, no same-turn activation. Respond only to opponent Normal/Tribute/Flip Summon >=1000 ATK after priority passes; target that monster. Multiple supported Traps resolve LIFO, cleanup after Chain. No ignition effects, negate, Special Summon implementation, modifiers or mixed responder effects. Rules for Trap timing/Chain from adopted format and rulebook baseline. Historical printed-text review remains pending.
